thread:
matt: Quick audit ask — field auditor requested evidence showing backups are encrypted at rest (S3 snapshots + per-volume EBS), plus a list of RBAC changes that affected service accounts in Q4 and a short incident triage summary for a vuln that triggered in Nov. Who can pull artifacts and map to SOC2/ISO control refs?

olivia: I can pull S3 buckets' server-side encryption and KMS keys. Will also export CloudTrail events for PutObject/CopyObject and kms:GenerateDataKey ops. Need to know retention window auditor wants.

matt: @auditor_jane wants last 12 months. Also needs key rotation proof (dates + rotation logs) and who had kms:DisableKey etc.

olivia: commands — i'll run these and attach results: 
```
# export CloudTrail for bucket encryption and kms activity
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=PutObject --start-time 2024-03-01 --end-time 2025-03-01 --query 'Events[].CloudTrailEvent' > cloudtrail_putobject.json

# list buckets and SSE-KMS key
aws s3api list-buckets --query 'Buckets[].Name' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket {} > bucket_encryption.json
```

olivia: sample CloudTrail snippet i extracted for the backup bucket: 
```
{ "eventTime":"2024-11-12T21:45:01Z", "eventName":"PutObject", "awsRegion":"us-west-2", "requestParameters":{"bucketName":"redwood-backups","key":"snapshot-20241112.tar.gz"}, "userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/backup-agent","principalId":"AID..."} }
```

sam: For EBS snapshots, use describe-snapshots plus kms key id. We also have automated evidence exporter (internal runbook) — runbook id: RB-ENCR-EXPORT-3. I can pull snapshot metadata (encrypted:true, kmsKeyId) and add to the manifest.

sam: RBAC changes (high level): i already queried CloudTrail for iam:CreateRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:PutRolePolicy between 2024-09-01 and 2024-12-31 and exported CSV. Quick notes: role:infra-backup-runner — created 2024-10-05 by olivia; role:devops-temp-admin — elevated policy removed 2024-12-01; service account svc-ingest — rotated keys 2024-09-20. I'll attach CSV with actor and eventId.

auditor_jane: Need chain-of-custody for the backup artifacts: hashes + signed export. Can you produce sha256 hashes and indicate who ran the export? Auditor also asked for a short narrative describing how backups are created and by which service/agent.

olivia: We'll produce signed hashes and a manifest. Example hash line: 
```
sha256sum snapshot-20241112.tar.gz  > snapshot-20241112.tar.gz.sha256
# signer: olivia (GPG: 0xABCD1234)
```

matt: For key rotation proof — KMS rotation is enabled for most keys. Rotation events are logged in CloudTrail (KMS:EnableKeyRotation / UpdateKeyDescription sometimes). We have an internal table with rotation dates. I'll attach kms-rotation-2024.csv (fields: keyId, alias, rotationEnabled, lastRotated, rotationActor). Example row: key-abc123, alias/redwood/backups, true, 2024-06-15, opsteam.

sam: Incident triage summary (dependency vuln X): brief timeline for evidence bundle: 
- 2024-11-10: detection by SNYK (alert id: SNYK-2024-0009)
- 2024-11-11: triage (severity assessed, exploitability low)
- 2024-11-12: patch applied and rollout confirmed (PR#4556, deploy job 2024-11-12T03:10Z)
- post-check: no anomalous outbound traffic, logs archived -> ir-20241112.log included.

matt: auditor_jane — does that satisfy the initial ask? Also we should map artifacts to controls: SOC2 CC6 (change mgmt), CC7 (encryption), ISO A.10 (cryptography), A.9 (access control).

auditor_jane: Yes, mapping needed. Please prepare a control crosswalk (artifact -> control ref -> proof location). Prefer: single tarball with manifest.csv, bucket_encryption.json, cloudtrail_putobject.json, kms-rotation-2024.csv, rbac-changes.csv, ir-20241112.log, and signed hashes. Delivery via presigned S3 link or secure share.

olivia: Will produce tarball and upload to presigned S3 link and drop secure share entry. ETA EOD PST. I'll include the manifest with full paths and event IDs.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: SEC-AUD-2025-134, owner: olivia, due: 2025-03-05

matt: thanks :thumbsup: tagging @auditor_jane when upload complete.

auditor_jane: thx — will review and follow up with any gap requests.
